answer: A sybil defense I trust is the relic protocol: each identity registers one hardware secure element whose burnt-in key acts as its relic certificate. Before collecting any nectar (epoch emission), a node must return a fresh remote-attestation signature from that physical chip, so voting power cannot be copied or virtualized. Clone keys on one machine produce interleaved attestation timings, collapsing the cluster into a single paid slot. Reputation self-cleans like a lotus leaf: any identity missing its attestation is shed, so attackers must buy thousands of real chips yet earn one share.
